headline: Ben Bernanke on *too big to fail*
quote: there is something fundamentally wrong with a system
title: Bernanke: Why too big to fail creates massive risk
caption: Ben Bernanke argues that implicit government bailouts distort financial incentives by encouraging mega-firms to take extreme risks. He warns that a system allowing 'too big to fail' institutions cannot be tolerated.
comment: Do you think modern megabanks are still too big to fail?
